patthana16.95:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.95:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.95:4.1: sanidassanasappaṭigho araṇo dhammo na sanidassanasappaṭighassa na araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana16.95:6.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. anulomapaccanīya tikadukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. anulomapaccanīya tikattikapaṭṭhānaṃ kusalattika vedanāttike nakusalattika navedanāttikaṃ
